selection: Esme was the first listed restaurant in the initial Climbing section with confirmed SF geography and regular dinner service. Depth-first pilot, not representative sampling.
collector: agent-browser; resy-discovery observations with resy-listed-pilot official-policy corroboration
procedure: Use an isolated session, load agent-browser skills get core, verify UTC and America/Los_Angeles clocks, and discover Esme through the SF city page.
Open the Resy venue URL with ?date=2026-10-01&seats=2, wait for Need to Know, then read and snapshot -i -u. Follow the linked official restaurant website.
Inspect representative October 8 availability and October 5 closure before processing October 1–28 in order.
For each date open https://resy.com/cities/san-francisco-ca/venues/esme-ca?date=YYYY-MM-DD&seats=2. Wait until .ReservationButtonList exists or body text includes no online availability.

Read-only eval records new Date().toISOString(), URL date, first select value 2, selected-date labels or date-specific availability text, button.ReservationButton IDs and .ReservationButton__time/.ReservationButton__type. Filter visible starts to 18:00–21:00 inclusive with All Day selected.

Read messages from .ShiftInventory__availability-message,.ShiftInventory,.ReservationButtonList. Preserve no-availability messages as unknown because the two-person release policy was not established.

A second scout expanded the official Reservations and Hours accordions and verified aria-expanded=true. Its precise policy evidence below corroborates Monday closures; this capture combines that later policy evidence with the earlier 28-date observations.
On navigation/wait failure stop, leaving unexamined dates missing. No such failure occurred in this 28-date loop. Both scouts closed only their own sessions.
limitations: Two-person booking-window/release policy unresolved. The official two-week window and $75 price apply only to groups of 7–12, not to this party of two.
Inventory wait checked message/list appearance, not a documented fully-settled application state; successful inventory HTTP responses were not independently recorded in the original loop.
Later sessions encountered inventory preflight HTTP 500 failures. This earlier capture is preserved as reported evidence, not evidence of current availability.
The next-availability message repeatedly named October 8 even when the queried date was later. It was not used as the earliest-available-date calculation.
No checkout was opened; restrictions or prices revealed only after slot selection remain unverified.
Metadata and closure evidence come from the second scout at precise timestamps; availability observations come from the first scout. This is not a simultaneous snapshot.

restaurants.name: Esme
restaurants.reason: Official regular dinner service and Resy booking link; public Dining Room slots for two observed. Separate event inventory and walk-ins were not counted.
restaurants.bookingPolicy: Regular reservations through Resy; Monday closed, Tuesday–Sunday 17:00–21:00. Two-person release window unresolved. Large-party release and pricing policies do not apply.
